title: Build a PS3 fastfile
summary: Package a saved map and its raw assets into a PS3 map build.
outcome: An output folder containing the .ff and matching .pak.

sections.title: Package the map

steps.title: Save and open build
steps.text: Choose Build → Build .ff. The editor applies valid pending fog values and saves the map before opening the build window.

steps.title: Set inputs
steps.text: Confirm Asset library points to raw models, materials, textures, FX, and sounds. Choose an Output folder; the builder creates a folder containing the .ff and matching .pak.

steps.title: Run and review
steps.text: Choose Build PS3 fastfile. Read the build log and use Show in map if an error identifies a selectable object. After success, choose Preview compiled map for the generated .d3dbsp.

tips: If fog fields are invalid, correct them before the build window opens. If the asset library is wrong, choose the raw folder used by your placed assets.
